structured.answer: The page "מה האתר עוד לא מכסה" says the rules for all the products listed are still being checked and the site doesn't calculate them yet. As far as I read, that includes structured deposits and structured products, foreign-currency and dollar-linked deposits, the bonus on structured deposits, manager's insurance and savings policies, corporate bonds, gold and a few more. So I won't rely on the site for those, and I'll ask my son or the bank.
